status: frozen before any evidence run (freeze commit recorded in the worklog); amendments only as labelled appended entries
batch_class: suffix batch WL93B (user brief 2026-11-13): continues the WL93 architecture question with WL93A evidence; the existing WL93 tied / untied / capacity-matched implementations at the WL93A smoke scale; no new architecture class or mechanism. WL93 STOPPED-INCONCLUSIVE (Amendment 1 pending approval) and WL93A NO_SIGNAL_AT_SMOKE_SCALE are preserved
question: At smoke scale, does source / receiver factor separation alleviate the source-stage versus whole-transport accuracy conflict observed in WL93A, beyond parameter-capacity effects?

hypothesis.H_SHARING: untying source and receiver local factors reduces the whole-transport regression associated with source-stage supervision while preserving its source-stage benefit

inspection_disclosure: T0 / TQ results (WL93A) were inspected before this protocol; U0 / UQ / C0 / CQ quality has never been observed (WL93 stopped before training, the WL93 dev chain used 48 geometries / 200 steps / Mq 64 and is not evidence)
invariants: ECRO / model86 generator class, frozen ER materials and path semantics, deployed 16-sample source encoding, local rank 16, widths, backbone and geometry interface, global branch frozen to WL92A own_s<seed> (identical across arms, tested), WL92A split, WL93A training subset / targets / references / optimisation, existing thresholds; no runtime oracle
models: experiments/ecro_stage93/model93.py unchanged: untied = receiver heads head_c2 / head_a2 copied from the source heads (shared trunk); tiedcm = one shared (c, a) = softplus(head + head2), head2 hidden layers from torch.Generator(seed + 9300), output layer zero (WL93 freeze c30c797 definition); every arm equals WL92A own at step 0

training.contract: WL93A task_b.training unchanged: the WL93A 128-geometry train subset, WL93A B0 training targets (seeds 93.5M range) and training-validation targets (93.6M range), 2,000 steps, Adam, lr 3e-4 -> 1e-5 cosine after 200 warmup steps, clip 10, one geometry (4 lightings) per step, order rng(seed + 93), seeds 8601 / 8602; objective OWN + w x WL93 source-stage loss (w = 1 for *Q)
training.reproduction_controls: R_T0 / R_TQ: T0 and TQ retrained here under the identical contract (both seeds) to verify the reused WL93A checkpoints and to measure run-to-run variation r_m; STOP (historical controls not reproduced) if any validation whole / single-vs-L2 / source-stage (training-validation target) relative L1 of R_X differs from the WL93A X by more than 2 % relative
training.no_extension: no extra steps, no seed replacement, no weight change

references: WL93A B5 four-realization evaluation references (data/qref, seeds 93.1M range; independent of every training target) on 16 train-representative, 55 validation (g00010 included everywhere) and E2 T0 / T1 configurations; WL86 targets t (f, fb), WL92A exactly-2-event targets t2 (f2, f2b); E2 truth split D (WL92B)

accounting.source_stage: Bq = a_s (c_s s) vs B5: relative L1 vs the B5 mean (primary SRC), cross-product relative L2 M (sqrt of a ratio of two unbiased cross-product estimates; the ratio / sqrt is not exactly unbiased), flux / directional split, peak-bin retention
accounting.receiver_stage: R_q = a_r (c_r flight(q_B5 mean)) vs t2 (receiver use given the physical once-scattered field; exact-local floor M64 flight(q_B5 mean) vs t2) and the receiver use on the model's own first flight vs M64 on the same field
accounting.single_flight: S vs t2: relative L1 (SINGLE) and cross-product relative L2 with the f2 / f2b halves
accounting.whole: S + G vs t: relative L1 (WHOLE, primary) and cross-product relative L2 with the f / fb halves
accounting.distribution: per-geometry values, median / IQR, count of geometries improved, top shares; the WL93A high-confidence subgroup (B5 noise <= 0.10, previously inspected) as a clearly secondary analysis
accounting.operators: panel source / receiver matrices a c^T vs frozen-ER M64 on E2 T1 (flux norm: residual, mirror-bin retention) and the relative source - receiver difference (role separation vs a single intrinsic material response)

uncertainty: paired geometry bootstrap (2,000 resamples, seed 93002) of pooled-metric differences over the 55 validation geometries (SE); run-to-run variation r_m = max over seeds and X in {T0, TQ} of |m(R_X) - m(X)|; WL93A B5 pairing spread for M

criteria.notation: per seed s; SRC = validation panel source-stage relative L1 vs the B5 mean; WHOLE / SINGLE = validation whole-table / single-vs-L2 relative L1; gap_s = WHOLE(TQ_s) - WHOLE(T0_s); gain_s = SRC(T0_s) - SRC(TQ_s); margin_m = max(2 SE(paired difference), r_m)
criteria.a_source_preserved: SRC(UQ_s) <= SRC(T0_s) - 0.5 gain_s AND SRC(UQ_s) <= SRC(TQ_s) + margin_SRC
criteria.b_whole_vs_TQ: WHOLE(UQ_s) <= WHOLE(TQ_s) - max(margin_WHOLE, 0.5 gap_s) AND SINGLE(UQ_s) <= SINGLE(TQ_s) + margin_SINGLE
criteria.d_no_compensating_regression: renders vs same-seed T0: stationary_all and D E_H <= 1.25 x T0 + 0.002 on E2 T0 / T1, E5k995 T0 / T1 and E1 T1 LSPOT; no WL86 gate passed by T0 lost (F1 T0 / T1, F2 A / D at T1, F3 D on E2 / E5, F4 stationary on E1 LSPOT)
criteria.SHARING_SIGNAL: a, b, c, d for both seeds
criteria.CAPACITY_EXPLANATION: a and b for both seeds, c fails for at least one seed, and CQ meets b (CQ in place of UQ) for both seeds
criteria.TRADEOFF_REMAINS: a for both seeds and b fails for both seeds
criteria.NO_ADVANTAGE: b fails for both seeds, a fails for at least one seed, and U0 shows no whole improvement over T0 for either seed (WHOLE(U0_s) > WHOLE(T0_s) - margin_WHOLE)
criteria.INCONCLUSIVE: any other combination, or a failed control / test / reproduction
criteria.order: STOP / control failure -> INCONCLUSIVE; else SHARING_SIGNAL, CAPACITY_EXPLANATION, TRADEOFF_REMAINS, NO_ADVANTAGE, INCONCLUSIVE (first match)
criteria.descriptive_contrasts: U0 vs T0, UQ vs U0, CQ vs C0, UQ vs CQ, C0 vs T0 with the same margins (not additive shares)
criteria.note: labels are smoke-scale feasibility evidence only; none validates an architecture

renders.models: 6 arms x 2 seeds + WL92A own (reproduction of WL93A renders)
renders.references: existing WL86 / WL92B REF-ER (inspected conditions); LPAT: new REF-ER 8 x 8,192 spp, seeds 93810 + r

pattern_diagnostic.role: visual diagnostic only; never enters the verdict
pattern_diagnostic.interface_limit: the source interface (scene86.light_arrays) admits at most two lights; a multi-cell checkerboard is not expressible without changing the source contract -> reduced to a 2 x 2 checker: two hard-edged cone lights (the existing cone class, as LSPOT) illuminate the two diagonal 40 cm cells of a 2 x 2 cell block on the panel; the two other cells stay unlit
pattern_diagnostic.geometry: E2 T1 geometry; panel cells y [-0.1, 0.3] x z [0.9, 1.3] and y [0.3, 0.7] x z [0.5, 0.9] (cell edges on the 20 cm patch grid); lights at x = -0.3 (1.2 m in front of the panel) and 0.8 m toward -y of the cell centres, aimed at the cell centres (oblique, so the rays clear the moved box B at T1), cone half-angle atan(0.13 / 1.44)
pattern_diagnostic.pre_freeze_correction: the first design (lights straight in front, cone radius 0.17 m) failed the representability gate in the dev chain: the moved box B at T1 shadows the second cell completely (all 4 patch levels 0); corrected before any evidence run and before any model output on the pattern existed
pattern_diagnostic.flux: both lights equal; intensity scaled so that the panel-incident flux (patch area x encoded incident level) equals that of the E2 L1 light on the E2 T1 panel
pattern_diagnostic.representability_gate: before any render, from the deployed encoding s16: every patch of the two lit cells >= 0.3 x the maximum lit-patch level, every other panel patch <= 0.05 x that maximum; otherwise the pattern is omitted from evidence (reported). No above-Nyquist stress pattern is run
pattern_diagnostic.evaluation: masks masks86.compute('E2', ls = 'LPAT'); E_H (region C / stationary) and aligned crops of reference, tied, untied and differences on one shared scale; caveat: the cone source class was never used in training (LSPOT is a held-out class)

tests.T_REUSE: WL93A T0 / TQ checkpoints load and their state hashes equal the WL93A recorded final_sha256
tests.T_INIT: every arm equals WL92A own on E2_T1 at step 0 (<= 1e-5); T0 / TQ / U0 / UQ / C0 / CQ initial outputs identical
tests.T_OWNERSHIP: untied: a source-only loss gives zero gradient to the receiver heads and non-zero to the source heads; tied / tiedcm: c_s / c_r are the same tensor
tests.T_CAPACITY: trainable parameters untied = tiedcm > tied; after training C0 / CQ differ from T0 / TQ (> 1e-4 relative, non-degenerate)
tests.T_TARGETS: training-target / training-validation-target / evaluation-reference seed sets disjoint; training and evaluation targets are different files
tests.T_SPLIT: train subset vs validation disjoint by geometry content hash
tests.T_RENDER_REF: re-rendered WL92A own E2 T1 / T0 equals the WL93A render (region-C E_H difference <= 1e-6); reference files are the hashed WL86 / WL92B renders

scope: smoke scale; inspected conditions only (no held-out claim); no full-scale training, no new held-out suite, no rank / width / loss-weight / threshold change, no successor
